searchText: It would be great if each EL client could have one person in the PeerDAS breakout today at 11 CET just checking my logic - this should mean that platforms using `tx.origin == msg.sender` could replace it (assuming proxies, otherwise a redeploy) with something like `require(EXTCODESIZE(tx.origin) == 0)`? (That's not valid Solidity, I know) You want to verify that the sender is the EOA so you have to check `tx.origin == msg.sender` and `EXTCODESIZE(tx.origin) == 0`. But yes the logic is correct the EXTCODESIZE will return 23 if an EOA is delegated here. But in general you should not ban non-EOAs from interacting with a contract 🙂 If this is a recurring concern and pattern I wonder if we should adopt EIP-7880 EXTCODEADDRESS in legacy as well (it's currently targeted at EOF only).
